name: hud_ui_timer_panel_zar_read_timer_data
description: HudUiTimerPanel::ZarReadTimerData reads the first TimerData float into the timer display and begins objective presentation.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S comparison is deferred to a HUD timer panel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x40fbb0 validate reading the first 4-byte float from the buffer, ignoring byteCount, calling HudUiTimerPanel::UpdateHMSFromSeconds on userData, calling HudUiMgrObjective::Begin, and stdcall cleanup of three arguments.

0x40ee60 HudUiTimerPanel::UpdateHMSFromSeconds is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_timer_panel_update_hms_from_seconds, and 0x411a20 HudUiMgrObjective::Begin is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_mgr_objective_begin.
The native timer-panel ZAR read smoke calls ZarReadTimerData with a TimerData float and verifies the timer elapsed/text display update plus the objective Begin side effects.
